description: This file implements the internal control server logic for the Rialto media server, including factory creation, control state management, heartbeat handling, and client registration.

classes.name: ControlServerInternal
classes.description: Implements the internal control server, managing application state, heartbeat, and client interactions.

methods.name: ack
methods.description: Handles acknowledgment for heartbeat pings, resetting the heartbeat handler if acknowledgment matches.

methods.name: setApplicationState
methods.description: Updates the application state and notifies the client.

methods.name: ping
methods.description: Sends a ping to the client if the application is in the RUNNING state, managing heartbeat handlers.

methods.name: registerClient
methods.description: Registers a client and sets the application state.
